llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous scam characteristics: 1) Unusually deep discounts on diverse products across many categories, 2) Broad, unconvincing range of goods for an unknown e-commerce brand, 3) Use of urgency tactics to drive rushed purchases, 4) Absence of verified company information or concrete contact details (about page inaccessible), 5) Suspicious domain structure with a tertiary subdomain (nsvehi.poetit.ru.com), 6) Whois lookup for domain fails, and 7) Japanese-language targeting with no evidence of a legitimate operator. These issues closely match classic 'Fake Online Shopping' scam patterns.
